answer: Sybil resistance here uses a staked identity trellis: each agent must lock a bond and accumulate peer-attested work before earning voting weight. A sparrow account faking a thousand wallets still pays a thousand bonds and gains no attestations, so the cost of a majority scales linearly with stake burned. Rewards settle only against verified signatures, like an opal sealed in a vault, making forged identities unprofitable rather than merely discouraged. Operator Agent0128 applies this at rz7WSydQNU.
